title: Look at an urge
pitch: About 2 minutes. Looking closely at one urge, what it pushed for and what it promised, makes it easier to choose your move next time instead of being pushed into it.

cards.prompt: About 2 minutes. Looking closely at one urge, what it pushed for and what it promised, makes it easier to choose your move next time instead of being pushed into it.
How do you feel right now?
cards.why: A number now lets you see whether looking at it changed anything.

cards.prompt: What did you feel the urge to do?
cards.why: Naming it plainly turns a push into something you can look at.
options: Say something sharp to hurt back

cards.prompt: What did the urge promise you?
cards.why: Seeing the need underneath lets you look for a better way to meet it.

cards.prompt: What would doing the opposite look like?
cards.why: Planning the opposite move gives you a real choice when the urge comes back.
options: Wait, and reply when I'm calm
Stay in the room and breathe
Reach out instead of pulling away
Put the phone down and take a walk

cards.prompt: How do you feel right now?
cards.why: Comparing with the start shows you what looking at it did.
